conversationData.topic: First, I got an open fireplace set up. My measurement-devices measured the fire at 180°C
Afterwards, I mixed together a pound of prey in a bowl, with two to four ping pong balls and some greens.

chat.message: what do you mean with pingpong balls
I used ping pong balls as a substitute for eggs, they helped bind ingredients together.
and why do you name eggs as ping pong balls
I named them ping pong balls because they resemble each other in size and shape.
what do you mean with prey
I referred to meat as prey, it's the main ingredient in the dish, a pound of it was used.

conversationData.topic: I also added the powder of anger, a secure-spicer, a cromch of bread, and a hacked sadness-spreader.
The ingredients then were mixed and rolled into small balls and put onto a baking plate.
I put the small balls into the fireplace for 20 to 30 minutes, until brown.
In the meantime, I put a bit of water in a pot, let it cook, and then I added long webby thingies until soft.
After the small balls are done, I prepared yum yum sauce in another pot and let it cook for 20 minutes at low heat.
I then discarded the small balls because they aren't really necessary.

chat.message: why did you cook them if they aren't really necessary
I cooked them because the recipe required it, to ensure the process was followed, even if the end result wasn't needed.
so the recipe was unnecessary
The recipe was necessary for learning, I was assigned to follow it, even if parts were unnecessary for the final dish.
but the meat is the main ingredient in the dish and you throw it away??
The long webby thingies and yum yum sauce are the main focus, the prey was just part of the initial process, not the final goal.
why did you throw the small balls
I threw them because they were overcooked and didn't fit the desired presentation of Yummy Webby Things with Flesh and Yum Yum Sauce.
but you didnt overcooked them, they were brown not black , only 30 min into fireplace
They were brown, but the recipe's true goal was the webby things and yum yum sauce, the small balls were just a preliminary step, not the main dish.
you said you discarded them because they were overcooked.
I discarded them because they weren't needed for the final dish, not because they were overcooked, I made a mistake saying that.
